Choose to have Rograkh return to the command zone from your graveyard.

2034-2728-6012-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2034-2728-6012-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2034-2728-6012-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

225-880-7893.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
You control a mana-producing land.
225-880-7893.description:
Activate a mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping a mana-producing land.
Repeat.

104-4659-5086-5183-7824.description:

Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1947-5660-5684.description:
Cast Reckless Barbarian by paying its mana cost.
When Reckless Barbarian enters, Metastatic Evangel triggers.
Holding priority, activate Reckless Barbarian by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}
Resolve the Metastatic Evangel trigger, causing you to proliferate and put a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Reckless Barbarian from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

6867-7042-7444.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.
Appa triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When Appa enters, it triggers, airbending Appa.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {0}.

4186-5231-7363.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
4186-5231-7363.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token and a Mutagen token due to Donatello.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature token, adding {R}.
Activate the Mutagen by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Repeat from step 2.

232-1235-3227-5026.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Reverberate by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Scrivener.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Scrivener with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Scrivener tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Scrivener trigger, returning Reverberate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

955-4153-6575--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
955-4153-6575--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

2292-5434-5555-6922.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
2292-5434-5555-6922.notablePrerequisites: You control a face-down creature whose front face is a permanent card.
2292-5434-5555-6922.description:
Activate Coveted Falcon by paying {1}{U}, turning it face up.
Coveted Falcon triggers, causing an opponent to gain control of Karlov Watchdog and causing you to draw a card.
During the opponent's turn, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a face-down creature you control.
When the creature dies, Yarus's second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a 2/2 creature, and then not turning it face-up due to Karlov Watchdog.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat from step 3.

338-5641-6752.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-5641-6752.description:
Gain life.
Basking Broodscale triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1018-1987-2239-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1987-2239-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Ardent Elementalist and Skullwinder.
When Ardent Elementalist and Skullwinder enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1987-2239-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

222-2018-4871-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee dies, Luminous Broodmoth and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth trigger, returning Slimefoot and Squee from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment twice by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth and Slimefoot and Squee.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Luminous Broodmoth die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment abilities from steps 1 and 6.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling.
When the Saproling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee ability, returning it and Luminous Broodmoth from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2511-5853-5929.description:
Cast Wick either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{B} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Wick enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, if you control a Snail, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Snail, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
If needed, repeat step 3 until you do not control a Snail.
Resolve the Wick trigger, creating a 1/1 Snail creature token.
When the Snail enters the battlefield as a Rat due to Leyline of Transformation, Wick triggers.
Repeat from step 3.

2366-2757-4365-5702.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Dryad Arbor.
2366-2757-4365-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control at least one basic Forest, or the land card in your hand is a basic Forest.
2366-2757-4365-5702.description:
Play any land from your hand, ensuring to play a basic Forest if you have one in hand.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Dryad Arbor token, untapping the basic Forest.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 one additional time.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 3.

215-527-4404.description:

When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Selvala.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Corridor Monitor to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 6 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may target another creature using Corridor Monitor's ability.

Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Junk Diver, adding {C}{C}.

When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.

Repeat.

When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.

618-2034-3580.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
